style: Original 3D black comedy, deadpan slapstick, vivid saturated colors, high contrast, original character design
subject: ONE old grey goose: white head feathers, round glasses on a chain, big cobalt-blue vest. Hugs a HUGE hot-pink piggy bank, half his size, round hole in its belly. Deadpan, never flies.
second_characters: ONE mole boss, grey suit, white hanky. ONE white rabbit clerk, orange suit. TWO clerks: ferret, beaver.
props: Piggy bank: goose's. Hanky: mole's. Gold coins: from the goose's piggy bank, then in the rabbit's pocket. ONE coin: rabbit's, then goose's. Moth: in the piggy bank.
environment: Emerald glass tower, open 40th-floor window; sunny-yellow tile plaza, revolving glass door at the base.
lighting: Bright morning sun; warm key on the goose's face, amber rim left, violet rim right. Hot-pink piggy bank and cobalt vest vivid against emerald glass and yellow tiles, always.
motion_rule: camera always moving in sharp 0.3-0.8 s moves from frame one, each ending on the gag; goose fills half the frame, except the close-up beats; from 8.15 s only goose and piggy bank in frame

audio.delivery: Goose alone, dry deadpan adult voice, beak free while speaking

timeline.a: From the first frame: in the window the mole shakes the goose's wing goodbye and with the same jerk yanks him over the sill, waving the hanky; behind the mole the rabbit, orange pocket bulging with gold.
Goose falls; gold coins pour from the hole in the piggy bank's belly.
timeline.c: dives under the belly hole, close-up

timeline.a: Goose flips back-down, piggy bank on his chest, wings pressed.
timeline.c: spins down round him through the coins

timeline.a: Falling, he straightens his glasses with a wingtip, face calm.
timeline.c: plunges ahead into his glasses, close-up

timeline.a: Coins rain on the tiles; the rabbit sweeps them into his pocket.
timeline.c: top-down, drops with the coins, coins in foreground

timeline.a: Goose lands back-first: tiles cave in, he lies in a hole, piggy bank whole on his chest.
Ferret and beaver hurry into the revolving door, glancing back at the hole with pity; the rabbit stops, takes ONE coin from his pocket, tosses it in.
timeline.c: swings up to the door, goose's head in foreground

timeline.a: Goose snaps the falling coin in his beak.
Goose sits up in the hole, piggy bank upright on his lap; coin in his right wingtip, beak free; he looks up at the rabbit's pocket and back.
timeline.c: whips to the pocket and back

timeline.a: He drops the coin in the slot: it rattles through and falls out of the belly hole onto his foot.
timeline.c: hurls itself at the slot, drops with the coin onto his foot, close-up

timeline.a: Goose drops the coin in again; it plops onto his foot again; he does not look down.
timeline.c: arcs low round the piggy bank

timeline.a: He peers into the slot; a moth flies out onto his glasses. Last frame: moth on his glasses, empty pink piggy bank behind.
timeline.c: dives into the slot and out, close-up
